sessions.name: jitter within accuracy is averaged; a 100 m jump starts afresh
missing or zero accuracy counts as 20 m
only the last 3 readings, each under 10 s old, are averaged
GPS course is used when moving at 2 m/s or more
compass when slow, only while fresh (under 3 s)
a compass reading taken before the first fix is used once a fix arrives, if fresh
set_position: heading from movement of 2 m or more
arrival: almost under 50 m, arrived under 15 m
turn words and arrow relative to the heading
set_target keeps the rider; reset forgets the rider but not the compass
